data.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Puebla Angelopolis by IHG
data.address: Perseo 2502, San Martinito, 72825 San Bernardino Tlaxcalancingo, Pue., Mexico
data.description:
Set in a modern tower in the Angelópolis neighborhood, this informal hotel is a 14-minute walk from the International Museum of the Baroque, 6 km from the Estrella de Puebla observation wheel and 9 km from the Great Pyramid of Cholula.
Understated rooms offer free Wi-Fi, coffeemakers and desks, as well as flat-screen TVs with cable channels. Suites add kitchenettes, and some have separate living areas and/or pull-out sofas.
Freebies include parking, and a breakfast buffet served in an airy dining room with panoramic city views. There's also a 24-hour gym, a business center, and a rooftop pool with city views.
